messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: small procurement update for next week — new vendor pre-check step and slight PO threshold tweak. Please read.
Tom Hwang: Quick summary please?
Priya Nair: Effective Mon: any new vendor with projected annual spend >= $4,000 needs a PO + brief vendor pre-check (security + commercial). Under $4k remains manager-approved.
Rita Fernandez: Does this affect renewals that push spend over the limit?
Priya Nair: Yes — renewals that move a vendor over $4k require the same pre-check and a PO.
Tom Hwang: Card purchases still allowed under $500?
Priya Nair: Yep. Corp card OK < $500. $500-$4k require PO request & manager approval.
Rita Fernandez: Emergency procurement path?
Priya Nair: Emergency path unchanged: 2 manager approvals + finance email sign-off, log in #procurement-emergencies and cc finance@redwood.com. We'll issue a retro PO.
FinanceBot: :calendar: Reminder set — "Procurement threshold change" will ping managers tomorrow at 09:00.
Tom Hwang: Noted, will update our vendor tracker and push the renewal list.
Priya Nair: Thanks — if you need the PO snippet or form link DM me. :thumbsup:
